openings.claim: Provisionally replace variable magnetic attraction with two slot-mounted mechanical saddles capturing nonworking corners and opening for inspection: two bent steel-strip bases with corner lips, two pivoting hold-down strips, cork contact surfaces and supplied bolts.
openings.discriminator: If saddles restrain both in-plane directions and lift without excessive play, both plates should stay within 1 mm after twenty strokes despite different magnetic pull checks. Magnet retention could show plate-dependent slip; equal stability leaves that rival viable. Displacement above 1 mm defeats retention; removal/complete return exceeding sixty seconds or touching the working edge defeats serviceability.
openings.probe: Use ruler and unfastened strips to check two corner captures, bolt access, exposed working edge and clearance throughout the stroke; stop if the envelope fails. If feasible, fabricate within eighty minutes. Compare magnets only if their configuration also fits. Within twenty observation minutes, use at most two configurations, three twenty-stroke runs and three timed removal/return checks each. Include spare plate and thick gloves in final run/check. Mark references away from working edge; measure displacement and complete-return time.
openings.uncertainty: Unprovided slot dimensions/locations must permit anchoring and corner capture without forbidden modification. Pliers bending, bolt lengths, strip stiffness and clearance sufficiency remain assumptions. Captive pivot bolts loosened with screwdriver must permit gloved service within sixty seconds without edge contact; neither retention nor service capacity is established.

lineage.reason: Preserves mechanical substitution, rival comparison, defeat conditions, feasibility stop, resource limits, uncertainties and declared uncertain fit.

decision: Bounded fabrication/comparison probe, not deployment. Drill only strips using existing slots; never drill, cut, heat or glue plate/carriage. Keep marked 30 mm edge exposed, all added hardware outside stroke clearance, and carriage attached to rails. Do not fabricate unless initial fit preserves every constraint; unknown resources cannot relax them.
